title: RecordingEventLine
description: One line of events.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md). detail is a short code, never a pose, a time or a fix; the Swift recorder writes events from a typed enum. Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: t never decreases, and each kind's detail is what RECORDING_EVENT_DETAILS in packages/contracts says (null for most kinds; a RecordingEnded value for recording_closed; a ThermalState for thermal; a degradation step for degradation; a lowercase UUID for image_anchor_detected; decimal digits for session_failed; a short lowercase code for configuration).

detail.description: A short code, a number as its decimal text, or null; what it holds depends on kind (see the doc).

kind.title: RecordingEventKind
kind.description: What happened (the doc lists each kind's detail).
